shadows.name: leaf-cut
shadows.purpose: Acetate leaf on the division board.

motion.name: hinge-step
motion.purpose: Single authored motion: leaf turn on section change.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Constructive action inside the active division.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #232b6d; color: #fff; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 3px; padding: 0.65rem 1rem; min-height: 2.6rem; font: 600 16px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 2px 2px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.25); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #2f3a8f; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #f5d76e; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: .5; cursor: not-allowed; box-shadow: none; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary or selective action with a hairline outline.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: #1b1c1e; border: 1px solid rgba(27,28,30,0.35); border-radius: 3px; padding: 0.65rem 1rem; min-height: 2.6rem; font: 600 16px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: rgba(27,28,30,0.06); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #f5d76e; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Danger Button
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { background: #b3261e; color: #fff; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 3px; padding: 0.65rem 1rem; min-height: 2.6rem; font: 600 16px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-danger:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #f5d76e; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Input
components.description: Text field with focused border tied to the division board.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.35rem; font: 700 0.75rem ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-input { min-height: 2.6rem; padding: 0.6rem 0.75rem; border: 1px solid rgba(27,28,30,0.35); border-radius: 3px; background: #fffefb; color: #1b1c1e; font: 400 16px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #f5d76e; border-color: #232b6d; }

components.name: Tab
components.description: Stepped index tab; active tab extends into the desk.
components.css: .ds-tab { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 1rem; min-height: 3.5rem; padding: 0.85rem 3rem 0.85rem 1.5rem; border: 0; border-radius: 0 6px 6px 0; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.08); color: #fbfaf5; font: 650 16px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-tab--active { background: #2f3a8f; box-shadow: -4px 0 0 #fbfaf5; } .ds-tab-count { padding: 0.15rem 0.45rem; border-radius: 2px; background: rgba(0,0,0,0.24); font-family: ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.78rem; } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #f5d76e; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Status Pill
components.css: .ds-status { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.4rem; padding: 0.25rem 0.5rem; border-radius: 2px; background: #e8e6df; font: 400 0.74rem ui-monospace, monospace; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-status-mark { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: currentColor; } .ds-status--ready { background: #dcebdc; color: #1d5b2a; } .ds-status--failed { background: #b3261e; color: #fff; }

components.name: Acetate Leaf
components.description: Reading surface with binding holes and cut-edge shadow.
components.css: .ds-leaf { position: relative; padding: 2rem 2.5rem; border: 1px solid rgba(27,28,30,0.2); border-radius: 2px 12px 12px 2px; background: rgba(250,249,245,0.92); box-shadow: 3px 3px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.28), 20px 28px 50px rgba(0,0,0,0.18); color: #1b1c1e; } .ds-leaf::before { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 2.5rem; left: 14px; width: 11px; height: 11px; border-radius: 50%; background: #232b6d; box-shadow: 0 5.5rem 0 #232b6d, 0 11rem 0 #232b6d; opacity: .85; }

narrative.overview: Una consola de operación con la física de un manual encuadernado: pestañas como índice, tableros de color por división y hojas de acetato como superficie de lectura. Sin KPIs decorativos: cada pantalla muestra estado real y acciones consecuentes.
keyCharacteristics: Hoja de acetato con sombra de canto
Mono tabular para datos de máquina

rules.name: The One Board Rule
rules.body: Solo el color de la división activa tiñe el escritorio.

rules.name: The Hinge Rule
rules.body: Un único movimiento: giro de hoja en dos fotogramas al cambiar de división.
